latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Noizai Video — Remove Noise from Video Audio.

- Instantly remove background noise from video audio using cloud AI; upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM (up to 500MB).
- Simple, prompt-based workflow—no sliders or presets needed. Just describe what you want, e.g., "remove background noise."
- Automatic API setup: creates tokens and sessions seamlessly; displays clear, user-friendly connection status.
- Supports credits, status checking, exports to 1080p MP4, timeline previews, and error handling for common issues.
- Designed for fast turnaround (30–90 seconds per export) and easy iteration for content creators.
